rationale: Evidence from iteration 3 (score 600.4, best so far): the oval finishes 20/20 in 1.68 s, with max_error 0.023 m and 0.05 line-loss events. The s-bend finishes 14/20 (progress 0.92), and its 6 failures are off-track exits. The slalom still fails every run (0/20), ending at progress 0.23 with about 1.8 line-loss events per run. Slalom is now the bottleneck, and its failures are sensing-limited: the robot loses the tape during sharp left-right alternations, so the sum of readings drops below 0.05. The sensor array spans only +/-0.03 m, so a lateral excursion of about 4 to 5 cm leaves every sensor off the tape. The sensors also sit at y = 0.05 m, so the steering reacts late to the curve. Steering oscillation of about 0.25 to 0.37 suggests the loop is lagging rather than overshooting badly. The changes below address this. (1) Widen the array to +/-0.04 m (7 sensors, 13.3 mm spacing) so the line stays visible at larger offsets. The weights stay proportional to x, scaled to +/-1 at the outer sensors. (2) Move the sensors forward to y = 0.07 m, which gives about 2 cm more lookahead and reduces the phase lag at alternations. (3) Scale kp from 2.2 to 2.6. Widening the span lowers the signal per metre of offset by about 25%, so kp is raised to keep the steering authority roughly constant, and the increase is kept modest to limit oscillation. base_speed stays at 1.0, kd 0.8, ki 0.15 and line_loss last_direction are unchanged, so the sensing and lookahead effects are the main variables. Expected result: slalom line-loss events fall from about 1.8 toward 0.5 or below, slalom progress rises above 0.4, and s-bend finishes stay at 14/20 or better. Oval time should stay under 2 s. Hypotheses for the next race: H1, slalom line loss is caused by lateral reach, so the wider array removes most loss events; H2, the forward sensors reduce the steering lag and cut steering_oscillation; H3, if oscillation rises above 0.4 on the slalom, kd or kp is too high for the new span. Next measurements: slalom progress and line_loss_events, s-bend completion and off-track count, and steering_oscillation and max_error on all tracks.
